# Test fixtures — not real news

Synthetic feeds for `npm test` and offline runs of `scripts/fetch-feeds.mjs --fixtures test/fixtures`.
Every title starts with `[TEST]` and every link points at `example.com` / `example.org`, so nothing
here can be mistaken for a real development. Never copy these into `public/feed.json`.
File names match feed ids in `feeds.config.json`.
